title.zh: 美SEC批准3倍杠杆比特币、以太坊等ETP
title.en: SEC Approves 3x Leveraged Bitcoin, Ether and Other ETPs

current_state.zh:
彭博ETF分析师Eric Balchunas表示，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）已依据《1933年证券法》批准3倍做多比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油及天然气的ETP。他分享的文件显示，Cboe BZX交易所提出的上市与交易这六只产品的规则变更申请获得批准，他称这对发行方Volatility Shares而言是一次重大胜利。

这一批准使美国投资者可获得的交易所上市杠杆加密资产敞口，从现有的现货与期货产品进一步扩展。Balchunas将这一结果称为相关产品发行方Volatility Shares的重大胜利。

这批产品为3倍杠杆产品，标的涵盖六类资产：比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油和天然气。获批的是Cboe BZX提出的允许其上市与交易的规则变更申请，依据为《1933年证券法》。
current_state.en: The SEC approved 3x leveraged long ETPs referencing bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas under the Securities Act of 1933, per Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas.

updates.background_zh: 3倍杠杆ETP旨在提供标的资产每日收益率的三倍回报，美国市场在股票和大宗商品领域已有同类产品上市交易。Cboe BZX一直是提交加密相关产品上市规则变更申请的交易所之一；纳斯达克、纽交所Arca和Cboe BZX等交易所还提出过通用上市框架，允许其在无需逐一获得SEC依据19b-4规则批准的情况下上市加密ETP。
updates.background_en: 3x leveraged ETPs seek to deliver three times the daily return of an underlying asset, and similar products already trade in the U.S. for equities and commodities. Cboe BZX has been among the exchanges filing listing-rule changes for crypto-related products; exchanges including Nasdaq, NYSE Arca and Cboe BZX have also proposed generic listing frameworks that would let them list crypto ETPs without individual SEC approvals under Rule 19b-4.
updates.market_impact_zh: 在Cboe BZX上市的杠杆ETP为美国投资者提供了合规的交易所渠道，以获得比特币和以太坊的三倍日内敞口，这可能传导至发行方用于管理敞口的现货与衍生品市场的交易与对冲活动。由于此类产品每日再平衡，真正与市场结构直接相关的是其资金流与再平衡行为，而非批准本身。
updates.market_impact_en: Leveraged ETPs listed on Cboe BZX give U.S. investors a regulated, exchange-traded channel for 3x daily exposure to bitcoin and ether, which can feed through to trading and hedging activity in the underlying spot and derivatives markets used by the issuer to manage exposure. Because the products rebalance daily, their flows and rebalancing activity, rather than the approval itself, are the mechanism most directly linked to market structure.
